arrival: ^The stomach has let our chyme through! Where does this golden path lead?
^To the small intestine. Digestion continues here, with help from several secretions.
^And what are all those soft little fingers on the walls?
^They are called villi. They line the whole small intestine. We will soon see what they do!
chyme: ^Our meal is now chyme, mixed with gastric juice. The pylorus releases it a little at a time.
^And pepsin has already cut the proteins into shorter pieces.
^Those pieces still need more digestion before they become amino acids.
starch: ^We worked hard on the bread in the mouth. Why is there still some starch?
^We helped with part of the meal. Food does not stay in the mouth long enough for salivary amylase to finish all its starch.
^The remaining starch passes through the stomach and meets pancreatic amylase here.
^Yip! The next helpers will finish the job!
